items.canonicalEnglishName: Swiss chard, washed and cut into pieces
items.notes: Explicit semantic review binds this raw-preparation target to USDA Swiss chard, raw. Washing and cutting the leaves into pieces do not change the food identity or imply a cooked state, so the raw SR Legacy record is the direct per-100-g nutrition reference. This binding does not infer cultivar, leaf-to-stem ratio, trimming loss, drained mass, cooking yield, serving size, or any preparation beyond the target's stated washing and cutting; cooked, canned, frozen, mixed-greens, or beetroot-and-chard identities remain separate.
